summary: we developed a health monitoring system  that can monitor BPM and lymphatic fluid pressure and alert the person and crew if a crewmate suffers from ann accident that made his BPM very high-low
details: it monitors BPM and and lymphatic fluid pressure. it works by taking the vibrations and pulse and converting it into a recordable electronic signal to display and monitor health. I used the coding language Arduino c++ we used wokwi to create a working simulation its creative because it uses cheap inexpensive piezoelectric discs to sense and convert the pulse and pressure and display it on a small reader our project can be integrated with ai for a smoother interface. we considered comfortability and user friendliness and made it small and light its supposed to be placed on the neck and collar bone
dataRefs: Primary Lymphatic & Circulatory Fluid Shift Experiment
